_about: The small games, one row each, for the 游戏厅 (scripts/arcade.html?dev=1 — Hanli's test page, never linked in the game) and the try page (scripts/try-game.html?dev=1&game=<id>). `id` is the module, scripts/games/<id>.js, which keeps the small-game contract (games/mount.js: `mount(container, { data, lang, reducedMotion }) → Promise<{ won, grade?, stars? }>`; a pure board module gets it from `mountPure`). `group` places it on the page; `scene` · `hui` · `task` say where the story embeds it. A new game registers here with its module; the page reads its name and how-line from the module's `meta`.

games._levels: 喂饼's levels, here once (2026-10-16): the beat gets them through Look (the task's deal, look.mjs), mount() alone reads them here. World 360×440: the 饼 at `bread` hung from `vines` (anchor `at`, optional `slack`), the fox's mouth at `mouth` (`fox_flip`: facing left), `stones` (x, y, w, h, a degrees), a `gust` puff at `at` blowing `to`, an optional `piece` (a 饼角, a star), `say` the hint. Each is solved by order alone; games/bots/bread.js holds the answers.

say.en: The bread hangs from a vine. Cut it.

say.zh: 石板斜着。饼角在高的那头。
say.en: The slab slopes. The corner is at its high end.

say.zh: 洞口有风。点一下那团风。
say.en: Wind at the cave mouth. Tap the puff.

art._about: Every painted part of 射鹿, one entry each; an entry whose file is not there yet is left out at mount (presentArt) and that part is drawn in ink, so a file landing at its path drops in with no code change. `at` is the picture's anchor (fractions), `w` × `h` its size. Stag poses (drink · look · walk · bolt; one 640×480 canvas facing right, one ground line): `at` over the deer's origin (the barrel's middle on the ground), in deer units (0.18 a pixel); the hit zones in deerarc.js are fitted to these. bow_rest · bow_drawn (cross-faded by the pull) and arrow: painted pointing right, `at` the grip / the arrow's middle, in scene units. reed · reed_stub (`axis` up: painted standing, `at` the base) and branch (`axis` right, `at` the end it grows from): `w` × `h` only their shape, the length in the level sets their size. ink_hit: `at` its centre. backdrop: the 00-deer scene's own painting (backdrops.json heisong-creek), `crop` [x, y, w, h] of its `size` in pixels laid over the whole board: its stream and stones run under the far bank where the deer drinks, its grass is his bank (the physics ground, deerarc.js groundAt, sits on them); optional `bank` and `water` entries cut other crops into the ground and the stream. The geometry of the parts still coming is a first guess: fix it here when the file lands.

games._levels: 射鹿 · 拉弓, a 愤怒小鸟-style prototype (2026-10-16) — in the 游戏厅 only; the story's 射鹿 is still `deer`. World 480×300: he stands on the near bank at the right (the bow at 426,192), the deer drinks to the left. `deer`: `x`, `face` (-1 looks left), `lift` {every, for} ms its head comes up, `walk` {to, ms, rest} back and forth. `wind`: + blows in his face (pushes the arrow right), − at his back; `gust` {amp, period, phase?} makes it rise and fall (a sine on top, the streamer, tufts and leaves show it as it is). `things`: a `reed` {at, h, lean?, breaks? (speed, default 5)} snaps when the arrow is fast enough, else turns it; a `branch` {from, to} turns it always. `hint`: after a miss, 银月's 「往左偏半寸」 and a tick left of the deer. games/bots/deerarc.js searches each level's aim.

say.zh: 溪边，那头鹿低着头在喝水。往后拉弓，松手放箭。
say.en: By the stream the deer drinks, head down. Pull back, let go.

say.zh: 风从溪上迎面吹来。先看风，后看鹿。
say.en: The wind blows off the stream, into your face. Wind first, then the deer.

say.zh: 风转到了背后，一阵紧一阵松。它边走边喝，箭要等它。
say.en: The wind is at your back now, rising and falling. It drinks as it walks: lead it.

say.zh: 芦苇挡在中间，头上横着枯枝；风一阵一阵的，等它歇。
say.en: Reeds in the way, a dead branch overhead, and the wind comes in gusts: wait for a lull.

games._how: 喂饭桶's feed (古四 on, the 物品 panel's 饭桶): the thing he chose hung on vines over the 饭桶, a level made each feed from the day's seed (rope-gen.js) and proved solvable before it is shown; alone it plays a sample day (`level` 1–5: tier 0–4 with the elements of that many days).
